verdict.rationale: HubSpot ships an official CLI (@hubspot/cli, installable via npm) documented for project scaffolding, initialization, and authorization, and this CLI is explicitly the interface for the Developer MCP server enabling agentic dev tools to interact with the HubSpot Developer Platform — directly supporting AI-native/agentic workflows. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of the CLI's AI-specific commands and broader community corroboration beyond first-party docs.
